infer_auto_device_map: infer an automatic device map for a PyTorch model given max memory per device
load_checkpoint_in_model: load a checkpoint into a model with a custom device map and optional disk offloading
set_module_tensor_to_device: move a specific model tensor to a target device like cpu, gpu, or meta
find_tied_parameters: find all groups of tied parameters shared across modules in a PyTorch model
compute_module_sizes: compute the memory size in bytes of each module and parameter in a PyTorch model
